composer.placeholder: Tell us about your trip — e.g. 4 days in Hyderabad with my parents
composer.reassurance: You’ll review what we understood before anything is planned.

story.title: One journey, planned with you and kept safe along the way

you.label: You
you.title: It starts with who’s travelling
you.body: Parents who can’t walk far, a first solo trip, children who need breaks. The plan begins with people, not places.

intent.label: Intent
intent.title: Say it your way
intent.body: Describe the trip in a sentence. We show exactly what we understood, and ask when something isn’t clear.

planning.label: Planning
planning.title: Planned for you, checked by you
planning.body: TravIndi’s planning service builds the itinerary and checks timings and opening days. Nothing is booked or changed without you.

journey.label: Journey
journey.title: A day-by-day plan with reasons
journey.body: Every stop says why it’s there. Costs we don’t know are marked “Cost unavailable”, never guessed.

liveChange.label: Live change
liveChange.title: When something changes, you hear first
liveChange.body: Crowds, closures or delays reported on your route arrive as a travel update, with where the information came from and how recent it is.

adaptation.label: Adaptation
adaptation.title: Compare, then choose
adaptation.body: See your current plan beside the suggestion and its impact on time and cost. Keep what you have if you prefer — every version is saved.

safety.label: Safety
safety.title: Safety that tells the truth
safety.body: Share your location for as long as you choose. SOS shows exactly who received your alert, and reminds you to call 112.

popular.title: Where most journeys begin
popular.description: The places travellers return to again and again — each one a doorway to its region.

hidden.title: The India most itineraries miss
hidden.description: Root bridges, crater lakes and canyon forts — worth the extra miles.

returning.title: Pick up where you left off, {name}

principles.sources: Changing information shows where it came from and how recent it is.
principles.approval: Nothing in your plan changes until you approve it — and every version is kept.
principles.costs: A cost we don’t know is shown as unknown, never guessed.
principles.sos: SOS shows exactly who received your alert. It never claims help is on the way unless that’s confirmed.
